decision.summary: A multi-axis step-like offset occurs in N/E/U centered at ~598–602: N jumps up, E down, U up. The offset is sustained through index 602, but no clear opposing return is observed within the allowed context (560–639); E shows only a slow partial recovery afterward. Hence status is uncertain. No other temporary offsets are confirmed inside allowed_context.

intervals.observation: N rises sharply (~+10 MAD) and E drops sharply (~−5 MAD) between indices 598–602; U shows a concurrent smaller rise. No opposing return observed within allowed context (560–639); E begins slow recovery after 602 but does not reverse the step. Interior sustained through 602, onset at 598.
